question:
Study the given bar graph that shows the number of students (boys and girls) in different schools on 1 July 2019 and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52d539197d7dae39f7595f0cd2108f42c61d066b02793931debb2c2ea586f3f7.png] 

If a pie chart is drawn for the data related to the number of girls in the five schools, then the central angle (in degrees) of the sector representing the number of girls in school C will be:
solution:
**Given:**

There are given bar graph that shows the number of students (boys and girls) in different schools on 1 July 2019

**Concept used:**

We know that the total angle at the center of the circle in a pie chart = 360°

**Calculation:**

The total girls in five schools = 320 + 400 + 580 + 540 + 560 = 2400

The number of girls in school C = 580

The angle = (580/2400) &
times; 360° = 87°

**∴ The central angle (in degrees) of the sector representing the number of girls in school C will be 87°**
